it’s definitely a good album, and it’s been growing on me. i really liked the opening with unexpected, and it really set the mood for the album. some of the slickest, pleasing-on-the-ears music i’ve listened to. feels like floating. my other favs are multiphase, january, and recently, forget.

temporary time, his previous album, remains my favorite. but filters shows up with a refreshingly soothing and feel-good vibe that i really dig.
